scope: Public research only, mapping all 17 existing private historical offers; no API, Git, registry, imports, state edits or final multilingual notices.

summary.newPrimaryResult: Lukylud explicitly documents bespoke sweeper/rotor for Pokeyland, article 20 May 2021 modified 28 February 2022, with real unwatermarked native 640×480 photo.
summary.scopeCaution: These are research-readiness categories, not integration/audit/publication completion. All currently inspected historical items remain private and Unknown.

items.name: Rotor Jump
items.readiness: Precise historical source and admissible real native photo; strongest new result.
supportedDetails: Inflatable sweeper game manufactured/customised for Pokeyland according to supplier Lukylud, with orange/brown PVC colours and park branding.
Real supplier photo shows a circular padded bed divided into sectors, peripheral numbered positions, a central rotating padded arm and Pokeyland logos.
Up to eight players and avoiding the rotating sweeper are supported by the 2021 announcement/2023 brochure; the supplier image alone does not establish operational rules.
limits: Photo was taken in a supplier-type yard, not proven at Pokeyland; do not describe background buildings as park scenery.
Article publication 20 May 2021 is not a delivery or opening date.
Lukylud relationship is primary evidence, but no reference/entity creation or model assignment performed.
Separate branding illustration is a commercial rendering and excluded.

items.name: Segway
items.readiness: Precise historical function/physical appearance available, but no admissible separate original photo found.
supportedDetails: Guided gyropode trips through the park, including alongside paintball areas, are described in 2015.
Le Lorrain 2017 composite shows standing riders, two broad wheels, a central handlebar and helmets on a gravel path bordered by timber.
limits: lorrain-segway-2017.jpg combines two different photos; excluded, no crop.
Ottonville page 14 mentions Segway but photographs child quads/pedal karts, not a Segway.
The reporter’s own 2016 route duration/distance is not an official fixed itinerary.
No model, current operation or present-day limits established.

items.name: Le Petit Robin
items.readiness: Historical function supported by a secondary-host reproduction of the official 2021 brochure; no physical stand photo.
supportedDetails: Children’s crossbow activity on adapted stands, separately listed from Tir à l’arc.
limits: Need original primary brochure or direct park text for stronger provenance.
AI-generated Scribd title says 2023 while brochure body says 2021; use body year.
No named photograph, material, target design, projectile type, stand count or current restrictions.

items.name: Saut dans le vide
items.readiness: Precise source and admissible real photo already retained; no redownload.
supportedDetails: Supplier Amazone explicitly names Pokeyland and the QUICKjump XL + Ripcord apparatus.
Photo shows a harnessed participant at the elevated departure platform, yellow mesh guardrails and burgundy metal tower; nominal 2017 caption also locates the jump on the climbing tower.
limits: 18 m tourism/reportage, 20 m device caption and 23 m tower caption measure different or unresolved things; omit exact height unless reconciled.
No exact opening/capture date, current operation or merged identity with Escalade.

items.name: Clairière de jeux
items.readiness: Historical identity and year-of-announcement improved; still no equipment-specific photograph or inventory.
supportedDetails: Official 2022 map distinguishes Clairière de jeux from Aire de jeux, barefoot path and Mini-ferme.
New full-page contextual check places the Clairière aux Jeux explicitly among Pokeyland’s 2019 novelties, described as a large family play area.
limits: 2019 is a novelty announcement, not independently proven first operating day.
6 April 2019 is the announced park season opening; do not assign that day to the Clairière.
No specific games, materials or layout safely identified.
Do not equate it to current playgrounds or individual giant games.

items.name: Mini-ferme
items.readiness: Precise historical visual content and admissible real photo already retained; root attribution review remains appropriate.
supportedDetails: 2017 image shows goats within a wooded enclosure bounded by plank fences, with rocks and bare ground/straw.
Contemporary 2017 novelty reporting and current official group page separately name the Mini-ferme.
limits: Gallery context supports mini-farm, but individual image lacks a nominal caption.
No assertion that these goats/layout persist now; no exhaustive species list.
Background net play structures are not part of the animal enclosure.

items.name: Boutique
items.readiness: Historical service identity only; source-specific location/use but no identified facade/interior.
supportedDetails: Mainstreet shop described in 2017; mask sales mentioned in 2020; official 2022 map lists Boutique as an activity sales point distinct from entrance cashdesk.
limits: New er2016-03.jpg and er2016-11.jpg show PokeyPaint welcome/store complex, not established as mainstreet Boutique.
No souvenirs/clothes inventory inferred.
Same map number in a later edition is not proof of renaming to La Pêche de Pokey.

items.name: Checkpoint
items.readiness: Specific historical notice supported; unsigned photo candidates require explicit parent attribution decision.
supportedDetails: Nominal 2015 report identifies woodland trenches and an underground command post.
New 2016 view clearly shows plank walkways, branch-woven retaining edges, earth berms and covered low entrances.
2017 view shows the same type of trenches/covered post and a curved corrugated shelter also seen in the nominal 2015 picture.
limits: No Checkpoint sign in unsigned candidates; owner match is an inference from the named 2015 unique trench setting and repeated structural details.
2015 nominal image is visibly signed and excluded from import.
Do not infer replacement by Cemetery; 2016 gallery also shows a physically different cemetery scenery.
Props are not demonstrated functional weapons or authentic military artefacts.

items.name: Mini-buggy
items.readiness: Physical notice possible from nominal 2015 image/text, but only signed photo located.
supportedDetails: Small black buggy with low seat, steering wheel, roll bar, four knobby tyres, red rear components and metal step; separate small quads behind.
The opening report describes paths among trees and distinguishes Buggy enfant/Mini-buggy from Mini-Jeep and children’s quad.
limits: Thierry Hauuy/Tout-Metz signature means research only; no crop.
No proven alias to current Crazy Kart, Kids Racer or Les as du volant.
No fuel/power/maker/model inferred.

items.name: Mini-Jeep
items.readiness: Historically established offer, but vehicle appearance not qualified.
supportedDetails: 2015 price list specifies adult/child two-seat format, distinct from buggy/quad; official tourism school guide published in 2020 repeats mini-jeep trips.
limits: No photograph tied specifically to this offer.
Do not borrow La Jeepy/Willys supplier specs from unrelated web results.
No current-status or later ride alias.

items.name: Pédalo
items.readiness: Identity and historical commercial presence only; no equipment-specific photo.
supportedDetails: Pedalo listed in 2015 and official 2020 tourism school guide.
limits: No shape, colour, capacity, number or exact waterside placement established.
Not an alias of electric Bumper Boat; no replacement established.
Search results for Lac de Madine and other venues excluded.

items.name: Terrains de pétanque
items.readiness: Short historical location/count fact supported; no actual courts visually identified.
supportedDetails: 2015 report names two courts beside relaxation/food space; 2016 reporter mentions free-use pétanque.
limits: No surface, dimensions or fence material inferred from general relaxation image.
No invented names for separate courts.
No current continuity or relationship to Clairière de jeux proved.

items.name: Lancer de hache
items.readiness: Identity on official map only; no specific installation evidence.
supportedDetails: Official 2022 map lists Lancer de hache as number 4, separate from archery and Petit Robin.
limits: No target material, lane layout, axe type, supervision or age inferred.
Search hits Lumberjack/Les Cognées/Diebling concern other venues.

items.name: Big Air Jump
items.readiness: Precise nominal source and admissible real photo already retained; no redownload.
supportedDetails: 2017 gallery caption explicitly names Big Air Jump and shows a participant jumping above the inflatable landing.
Stairs/guardrails and wooded setting visible; 2017 plan distinguishes this number 26 from Saut dans le vide number 24.
limits: Promotional heights conflict; do not reuse 18 m of the other jump.
2017 novelty documented, exact opening day not.
No present operation, device maker or retirement date established.

items.name: Labyrinthe géant
items.readiness: Historical identity/year and visitor use established; no physical form or admissible photograph.
supportedDetails: 2017 map number 7 and two contemporary reports identify the novelty; dated visitor testimony later that summer confirms a labyrinth visit.
limits: No hedge/maize/wood walls or thematic decoration proved.
Halloween haunted maze not explicitly identified as same permanent installation.
Exclude adjacent tourism listings for Vigy/Breidenbach and school schedules for other venues.

items.name: Quad ados
items.readiness: Distinct historical offer established; vehicle/circuit details unavailable.
supportedDetails: 2017 official map distinguishes Quad ados 34, Quad enfant 14 and Balade en quad 35; contemporary commercial offers also separate them.
limits: New 2022 municipal photos depict child quads, not evidence for this entity.
No inferred engine, cc, model, circuit, age threshold or current alias.

items.name: Balade en quad
items.readiness: Distinct historical guided-trip offer established; no named vehicle photograph or exact route.
supportedDetails: 2017 map names Balade en quad 35 separately from Quad ados; 2017/2018 promotion describes paid quad excursions.
2019 visitor report mentions adult quad trips but supplies no authoritative technical rules.
limits: Do not equate Balade/Randonnée to a later ride by inference.
No route, duration, model, fuel, licence or current state inferred from visitors.

photos.subject: Rotor Jump
photos.decision: Admissible candidate after parent review: real photo, no visible watermark, under 960 KiB.
photos.observations: Orange/brown sector mat, outer numbered pads, central padded sweeper arm, applied park logos; yard outside a metal-clad building.

photos.subject: Rotor Jump commercial branding rendering
photos.decision: Excluded: synthetic/commercial annotated illustration, not a real photo.
photos.observations: Perspective design rendering with arrows, logos and inserted figure.

photos.subject: Segway plus jump tower composite
photos.decision: Excluded from import: two-image montage, no crop.
photos.observations: Left depicts gyropode users; right depicts the tower; visual evidence for historical appearance only.

photos.subject: Trench paintball area, probable Checkpoint
photos.decision: Technically admissible real original; nominal owner needs parent review.
photos.observations: Plank trench floor, branch-woven retaining walls, low covered entrances, surrounding mature trees; no name sign.

photos.subject: Saut dans le vide
photos.observations: Harnessed participant at a yellow guarded platform on the burgundy steel tower; green overhead QUICKjump device and red lanyard; Pokeyland fox backdrop. Supplier caption explicitly says Free Fall Jump | QUICKjump XL + Ripcord — 20 m high — Pokeyland, France.
photos.decision: Strong nominated candidate; root visual and duplicate review required.
limits: 1000 × 1500 / 675727 bytes; image naturally served with these dimensions despite URL containing 1200.
No capture date or individual photographer identified.
20 m supplier specification diverges from the 18 m description used by tourism/reportage sources; do not silently choose one.
The supplier page establishes equipment identification, not a current operational or safety certification.

photos.subject: Mini-ferme
photos.observations: Goats in a wooded enclosure bounded by plank fencing, pale rocky blocks, bare earth/straw and mature trees. Raised net play structure visible behind the fencing.
photos.decision: Historical mini-farm candidate after root attribution review.
limits: Gallery introduction explicitly names mini-fermes, but this image lacks an individual nominal caption.
Goat presence and enclosure appearance belong to the photographed historical scene; no claim about present-day animals or layout.
Do not assign net structure in background to mini-farm itself.

photos.subject: Trench-themed paintball terrain; likely Checkpoint
photos.observations: Woodland trenches with timber paths, branch-lined edges and an entrance into a covered earth shelter. Gallery caption explicitly says trenches of 14–18 but does not name Checkpoint.
photos.decision: Potential historical photo; named-owner match remains to be accepted by root.
limits: Similar trench/underground-post setting to nominal Checkpoint 2015 source, but no Checkpoint sign visible.
Do not assign to another terrain or infer current status.

photos.subject: Trench-themed paintball terrain; likely Checkpoint
photos.observations: Woodland trenches with plank paths, a tank-shaped play obstacle and other military-theme props.
photos.decision: Potential historical photo; named-owner match remains to be accepted by root.
limits: Adjacent gallery photo and same trench setting, but only generic paintball caption.
Tank-shaped prop is not established as a real military vehicle.

photos.subject: Big Air Jump
photos.decision: Previously retained nominated real photo; reused without redownload.
photos.observations: Participant above inflatable landing, platform stairs/guardrails in wooded surroundings.

newSourceEvidence.shortQuote: Notre client, le parc de loisirs Pokeyland souhaitait qu’elle soit à son image.
newSourceEvidence.supplierClaim: Lukylud says it worked with designers on PVC colours and markings for the bespoke rotor/faucheuse.
newSourceEvidence.dateLimit: Publication/modification only, not physical installation or photo capture dates.

newSourceEvidence.publicationPeriod: 2022 municipal bulletin 30; precise publication day unknown
newSourceEvidence.shortQuote: SORTIE EXTRA-SCOLAIRE À POKEYLAND LE 25 JUIN
newSourceEvidence.finding: Primary organiser reports 66 participants. Page names Segway but photos show children on quads, pedal karts, ropes, climbing, barefoot path and bumper boats.
newSourceEvidence.exclusion: No separate photo for the 17 target offers identified. Page montage is research-only; not an attraction photo candidate. Children’s quad is not Quad ados.

newSourceEvidence.finding: Full context explicitly places Clairière aux Jeux among Pokeyland novelties 2019, rather than under a neighbouring park.
newSourceEvidence.shortQuote: une balade en Petit Train et la Clairière aux Jeux
newSourceEvidence.dateLimit: A seasonal novelty announcement. The nearby 6 April 2019 is park reopening, not independent proof of first day for this zone.

methodAndLimits: All downloaded originals preserved unmodified, no crop or composite removal.
No new operational status or closure inferred from absence on current map.
No exact opening/capture dates invented; all access times are retrieval times only.
No current offer alias assigned from map numbers or generic resemblance.
Supplier references require root duplicate/identity review before any server linkage.
2023 brochure and old reports are preserved; Big Air/Mini-ferme images were not redownloaded.
Le Lorrain page existed already and was inadvertently downloaded again once in this separate research folder; no image import, existing evidence unchanged.
No social login, paywall or archive 429 bypass attempted.
LorraineAUcoeur HTML is Windows-1252; native bytes retained, corrected decoding saved as separate text file.
